standard_prerequisites: the recursion equations for ordinal addition at limit ordinals
the strict-supremum description of ordinal addition at omega
core_obligations: Prove that ordinal addition is not commutative by computing 1 + omega = omega while omega + 1 is the successor of omega, hence strictly larger
proof_roadmap: Compute 1 + omega as the strict supremum of the finite partial sums 1 + n over n < omega, which is omega
omega + 1 is the successor of omega by the successor recursion equation
Since omega is not its own successor, 1 + omega differs from omega + 1
difficulty_reason: A single-chain computation; each equality follows from the recursion equations, but they must be strung together correctly.
